description: A configurable dotnet new template and lifecycle toolkit for standardized .NET 8 solutions: layered microservices on PostgreSQL or SQL Server with CI, deployment and tests. Secrets from Infisical or HashiCorp Vault, RabbitMQ with a transactional outbox, Hangfire jobs, ClickHouse, MongoDB, email, object storage and a YARP gateway come by flag. Its tool dotskit (SawKing.DotsKit.Tool) adds services and flags to a solution and upgrades it to a new version, keeping the team's code.
releaseNotes:
dotskit keeps a solution up with the template, keeping the team's changes.

- A solution keeps up with the template: dotskit adds services and flags to it and upgrades it to a new version, keeping the team's changes.
- A service generated into a solution adds itself to All.sln.
- Email by flag, with a sandbox that keeps a test stand from mailing real people.
- MongoDB by flag, beside the main database.
- Containers run on a read-only filesystem.
- The test servers start with one command, the same on a developer's machine as in CI.
- Coverage on demand, with a report per service.
- The solution is generated with --Solution; -M false still works.
- The template answers to the short name dotskit too: dotnet new dotskit.

How to update a solution generated from an earlier version: https://github.com/sawking-tech/DotNetSolutionKit/blob/v2.8.0/docs/getting-started/upgrading.md
title: DotNet Solution Kit
